description: Add a kit component, or replace the one with this id, from the kind's typed payload (for example key_takeaways as {items:[{claim_id}]}). Every item binds to a kit claim and may state only that claim's figures and names; the payload is rebuilt against the claims. Raw {markdown} payloads and the sources kind are refused with 422 (add a fact instead). Editing an approved kit moves it back to needs_review. Send the kit_revision just read as expected_kit_revision; 409 kit_revision_stale means read the kit again. Never send Idempotency-Key.

body.description:
Add or replace a component with a typed payload (request).

``payload`` is the kind's structured shape (for example an FAQ's
``items`` with each answer bound to a ``claim_id``); it is rebuilt
against the kit's claims, so every figure and name it states must be in
the claims it cites. A raw ``{"markdown": ...}`` payload and the
``sources`` kind are refused with 422 (add a fact to add a source).
